# Geometry Dash Spam

Last updated: 2026-10-07

> GeometryDashSpam.cc is a fan-made browser toolkit for Geometry Dash spam practice, wave control, CPS measurement, source-checked Demon List references, codes, and related guides. It is not affiliated with RobTop Games.

Browser measurements on this site are training diagnostics, not laboratory hardware measurements. The wave trainer uses its own practice-oriented movement model and is not presented as an exact reproduction of official Geometry Dash physics. Time-sensitive rankings, codes, and related-game claims show a checked date and link to the source used for verification.

## Core tools

- [Geometry Dash Spam Test](https://geometrydashspam.cc/): Playable wave-spam practice with repeatable input-control metrics.
- [Geometry Dash Wave Trainer](https://geometrydashspam.cc/geometry-dash-wave): Normal, mini, precision, spam, and endless wave practice presets.
- [Geometry Dash CPS Test](https://geometrydashspam.cc/cps-test): 1, 3, 5, 10, 30, and 60 second click-speed tests with browser-side timing diagnostics.
- [Reaction Time Test](https://geometrydashspam.cc/reaction-test): Browser-observed visual response practice with Geometry Dash context and measurement limitations.
- [Aim Trainer](https://geometrydashspam.cc/aim-trainer): 30-second browser target-clicking practice for mouse accuracy and precision.

## Source-checked Geometry Dash references

- [Geometry Dash Demon List](https://geometrydashspam.cc/demon-list): Dated Pointercrate top-50 snapshot with a live-source link.
- [Spam Challenge List guide](https://geometrydashspam.cc/spam-challenge-list): Entry point to the maintained community Spam Challenge List and an explanation of how it differs from the Demon List.
- [Spam Demon references](https://geometrydashspam.cc/demon-list/spam-demons): Spam-heavy Demon practice references kept separate from SCL rankings.
- [Wave Demon references](https://geometrydashspam.cc/demon-list/wave-demons): Wave-focused Demon practice references.
- [Hardest Geometry Dash level](https://geometrydashspam.cc/hardest-level): Current #1 answer tied to the dated Demon List source.
- [Geometry Dash codes](https://geometrydashspam.cc/geometry-dash-codes): Vault, Vault of Secrets, Chamber of Time, and Wraith code reference with source-checked freshness.
- [Vault of Secrets codes](https://geometrydashspam.cc/geometry-dash-vault-of-secrets-codes): Dedicated Vault of Secrets code and unlock guide.
- [How to get Diamonds](https://geometrydashspam.cc/how-to-get-diamonds-geometry-dash): Progression guide for Diamond sources.
- [How to get Gold Keys](https://geometrydashspam.cc/how-to-get-gold-keys-geometry-dash): Source-checked Gold Key methods and current Wraith-code references.
- [Geometry Dash difficulty faces](https://geometrydashspam.cc/geometry-dash-difficulty-faces): Difficulty ratings and Demon sub-difficulties.

## Related games

- [Geometry Dash Breeze](https://geometrydashspam.cc/geometry-dash-breeze): Fan-made spinoff guide with maintained repository and release sources.
- [Dashmetry / Challenge Rush](https://geometrydashspam.cc/dashmetry): Current rebrand and playable-game source for the legacy Dashmetry query.

## Guides and site policy

- [Geometry Dash Spam guides](https://geometrydashspam.cc/blog): Practical spam, wave, CPS, input-method, and Demon-practice articles.
- [Top Geometry Dash Spam Levels](https://geometrydashspam.cc/blog/top-spam-levels-2026): Source-led guide separating Spam Challenge List rankings, spam-heavy Demons, and wave references.
- [About and measurement methodology](https://geometrydashspam.cc/about): How browser metrics are calculated and how claims are handled.
- [Contact and corrections](https://geometrydashspam.cc/contact): Bug reports, ranking corrections, source updates, and feature suggestions.
- [Privacy policy](https://geometrydashspam.cc/privacy): Local browser data and advertising disclosure.
- [Human-readable sitemap](https://geometrydashspam.cc/sitemap): Curated directory of indexable tools and guides.
- [XML sitemap](https://geometrydashspam.cc/sitemap.xml): Search-engine sitemap for indexable pages.


## Freshness and citation notes

- Use the linked page, not this file alone, for time-sensitive rankings, codes, releases or compatibility details.
- When a page shows a checked date, preserve that date when quoting a changing claim.
- Pointercrate positions are attributed to the dated Demon List source; Spam Challenge List rankings and rules belong to the maintained SCL source.
- Browser CPS, reaction, keyboard and pointer results describe events observed by the page. They are not laboratory hardware certifications.
- The wave trainer is a practice model, not an exact reproduction of official Geometry Dash physics.
- Corrections and source updates can be sent through https://geometrydashspam.cc/contact.

This file is optional interoperability metadata for systems that choose to read it. It is not presented as a Google ranking or citation signal.
